---
title: "Data and privacy"
---

Use the workshop's small, source-free synthetic data. It resembles survey/panel data so you can practise joins, metadata, flags, weights, missingness, and release checks. It is not SOEP, does not reproduce SOEP weights, and is not substantive evidence.

"Public" does not mean "approved for an external AI service." Before sending data, check institutional policy, contractual restrictions, provider retention and training settings, and account controls. In this workshop, never send restricted rows, unpublished results, personal or participant data, or credentials.

Check the [OpenCode Zen terms](https://opencode.ai/docs/zen/), [general OpenAI data controls](https://help.openai.com/en/articles/5722486-how-do-i-opt-out-of-my-content-being-used-to-improve-model-performance), and separate [Codex security and data guidance](https://developers.openai.com/codex/security/). For Google/Antigravity, check the current [permissions](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/permissions/) and [CLI usage](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli/using/) pages. Telemetry controls are not a confidentiality guarantee. Recheck these policies before publication.
